'''Tolkar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Tolkar worked as a [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] at a warehouse on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. At some point, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] accidentally routed a shipment of sixty five [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] to Barabel I and they were put into Tolkar's warehouse for storage. Although the rifles were valuable, the Empire did not know that they were on Barab I and they were taking up space in the warehouse, so Tolkar sold them to a group of freelance agents.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
